resources.string: Runs as: %1$s\nFree RAM: %2$d MB of %3$d MB
normal app (uid %1$d): this firmware does not accept the platform test key, nothing here will work
Suggested vendor apps: %1$d installed, %2$d disabled. Free RAM: %3$d MB.\nA disabled app stays installed but never runs; turn it back on any time.
All apps: %1$d, %2$d disabled. Free RAM: %3$d MB.\nOnly disable apps you know: some are needed by the system.

The firmware closes these apps 30 seconds after they leave the screen (%1$d apps, %2$d allowed to keep running). Turn the switch on for an app to keep running in the background, like the launcher with its FTP server or a keyboard. It stays set after a restart.
This firmware has no background kill setting.
The firmware did not change the setting (now: %1$s).
The firmware turns Wi-Fi off when the reader sleeps. Keep it on to find it already connected at wake-up; it uses a little more battery.
The reader will restart into the recovery menu. To come back to Android choose \"reboot system now\". Continue?
